name: 林志明
learned: 林志明 owns Hobbs Cafe and lives alone after his divorce. He likes to support local artists and knows most of the regulars by name. 李佳穎 works for him as a barista.
currently: 林志明 is preparing 周子豪's solo exhibition at Hobbs Cafe in four weeks and wants to turn it into a community event. He is also thinking about hiring another barista because 李佳穎 is often overworked.
lifestyle: 林志明 goes to bed around 11pm and wakes up around 6am.
